name: reload-ignores-scope
description: Reload loads every resource, scoped or not
old: let loads = (p == Ph::Reload && in_scope(r, l)) || in_current(r, p);
new: let loads = p == Ph::Reload || in_current(r, p);

name: own-phase-not-compiled
description: a scoped resource is not compiled in its own phase

name: generated-loaded
description: a generated resource is loaded from source

name: scope-ignores-phase-list
description: IsInScope ignores the command's phase list
old: pub open spec fn in_scope(r: Res, l: Seq<Ph>) -> bool { r.scope == Scope::NoScope || l.contains(scope_phase(r.scope)) }
new: pub open spec fn in_scope(r: Res, l: Seq<Ph>) -> bool { true }

name: verify-runs-test-phase
description: the verify command's phase list includes Test

name: export-ignores-manifest
old: let inc = match param { Some(b) => b, None => manifest };
new: let inc = match param { Some(b) => b, None => false };

name: explicit-param-cannot-drop
description: an explicit IncludeTests=0 cannot drop the manifest's tests
old: let inc = match param { Some(b) => b, None => manifest };
new: let inc = match param { Some(b) => b || manifest, None => manifest };

name: l1-ignores-generated
description: vacuity: L1 without the generated rule
old: pub open spec fn l1_present(r: Res, c: Cmd) -> bool { !r.generated && l1_compiled(r, c) }
new: pub open spec fn l1_present(r: Res, c: Cmd) -> bool { l1_compiled(r, c) }

name: generated-never-compiled
description: the earlier modelling error: a generated resource is never compiled
